name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.mem_allLists
typeText:
∀ (n L : Nat) (l : List.{0} Nat),
  Iff (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.allLists n L) l)
    (And (Eq.{1} (List.length.{0} l) L) (∀ (v : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} l v → LT.lt.{0} v n))

source.code:
theorem mem_allLists (n : ℕ) : ∀ (L : ℕ) (l : List ℕ),
    l ∈ allLists n L ↔ l.length = L ∧ ∀ v ∈ l, v < n
  | 0, l => by
      simp only [allLists, List.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · rintro rfl; simp
      · rintro ⟨h, _⟩; exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h
  | L + 1, l => by
      simp only [allLists, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨l', hl', v, hv, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨hlen, hall⟩ := (mem_allLists n L l').mp hl'
        refine ⟨by simp [hlen], ?_⟩
        intro w hw
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with rfl | hw
        · exact hv
        · exact hall w hw
      · rintro ⟨hlen, hall⟩
        cases l with
        | nil => simp at hlen
        | cons v l' =>
            refine ⟨l', (mem_allLists n L l').mpr ⟨by simpa using hlen, fun w hw =>
              hall w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw)⟩, v, hall v List.mem_cons_self, rfl⟩
